app.name: Chevarxona CRM
app.description: Custom tailoring and apparel manufacturing CRM

auth.demoBody: One click fills the form with working credentials (dev builds only).
auth.subtitle: Enter your workshop credentials to continue.
auth.passwordHint: Choose a password you do not use anywhere else.
auth.passwordChangedHint: Use the new password next time you sign in
auth.lostAccess: Lost access? Ask a workshop administrator to reset your password.
auth.heroTitle: Every stitch, every metre, every deadline — accounted for.
auth.heroBody: Client measurements, fabric reservations and the cutting-room queue in one place, so nothing is cut twice and nothing is promised late.
auth.heroFeature2: Bill of materials with live stock reservation
auth.heroFeature3: Kanban pipeline from draft to pickup

DRAFT.label: Draft
DRAFT.description: Being written up — nothing is reserved yet.

PENDING_DEPOSIT.label: Pending Deposit
PENDING_DEPOSIT.description: Waiting for the client advance payment.

MATERIAL_ALLOCATED.label: Material Allocated
MATERIAL_ALLOCATED.description: Fabric and accessories are soft-reserved for this order.

IN_CUTTING.label: In Cutting
IN_CUTTING.description: Fabric is being cut — stock is permanently deducted here.

IN_TAILORING.label: In Tailoring
IN_TAILORING.description: Assigned tailors are sewing the garments.

FITTING_STAGE.label: Fitting Stage
FITTING_STAGE.description: Client fitting scheduled or adjustments in progress.

READY_FOR_PICKUP.label: Ready for Pickup
READY_FOR_PICKUP.description: Finished and waiting for the client to collect.

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.description: Cancelled — any reserved material has been released.

SUPER_ADMIN.label: Super Admin
SUPER_ADMIN.description: Full system access including staff, settings, finance and audit logs.

MANAGER.label: Manager
MANAGER.description: Runs day-to-day operations: orders, clients, materials and tailor assignments.

TAILOR.label: Tailor (Chevar)
TAILOR.description: Sees only assigned garments, updates progress and logs consumed materials.

INVENTORY_CLERK.label: Inventory Clerk (Omborchi)
INVENTORY_CLERK.description: Owns fabrics, accessories, stock intake and material dispatch.

tour.empty: No guide for this page yet
tour.welcome: First time here — take the short tour

brand.title: Chevarxona CRM
brand.body: One workspace for the whole workshop: clients, measurements, orders and stock in one place. The tour takes about a minute.

sidebar.title: Section menu
sidebar.body: Work starts here: Orders (board, list, new), Clients, Warehouse (fabrics, accessories, movements) and Settings. Sections you have no permission for are never shown.

search.title: Quick search (⌘K)
search.body: Type a client name, a phone number or an order number and jump straight there instead of walking the menu.

quick-add.title: Quick add
quick-add.body: The three most common actions behind one button: new order, new client and a stock intake.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.body: Today's fittings and deadlines plus materials that dropped to their reorder point. The badge counts what needs attention.

language.title: Language
language.body: Uzbek, Russian and English. The choice is kept in a cookie and remembered on your next sign-in.

theme.title: Light / dark mode
theme.body: Switch the theme to suit the room — the choice is stored in your browser.

help.title: The guide button
help.body: Restart this tour whenever you like from here. Every main page has a guide of its own.

user-menu.title: Your profile
user-menu.body: Change your password, flip the theme or sign out from this menu.

dashboard-kpis.title: Key numbers
dashboard-kpis.body: Active orders, this week's fittings, stock running low and revenue for the month. Clicking a card opens the matching list with the filter already applied.

dashboard-pipeline.title: Pipeline and revenue
dashboard-pipeline.body: Where orders are piling up and how revenue moved over recent months — this is where the workshop's bottleneck shows.

dashboard-agenda.title: The next two weeks
dashboard-agenda.body: Fittings and deadlines sorted by date. Clicking a row opens the order.

orders-filters.title: Filters
orders-filters.body: Narrow by search, tailor and priority — the board updates immediately. The count on the right shows how many orders matched.

orders-board.title: Kanban board
orders-board.body: Each column is a production stage: accepted, cutting, sewing, fitting, ready, delivered. The column header carries the order count and its value.

orders-lane.title: Moving a card
orders-lane.body: Drag a card into the next column: the status changes and stock reservations plus the history update themselves. Without the status permission the board is read-only.

orders-new.title: New order
orders-new.body: Client, garment type, measurements, price and dates — all filled in on a single page.

new-order-client.title: Step 1: the client
new-order-client.body: Search by name or phone. If the client is not in the database yet, add them right here without leaving the order.

new-order-items.title: Step 2: the garments
new-order-items.body: Pick the type, fabric, accessories, measurements and tailor for each garment. One order can hold several garments.

new-order-summary.title: Step 3: price and dates
new-order-summary.body: Discount, advance payment and the remaining balance are calculated for you, and the date fields suggest a realistic turnaround.

new-order-bom.title: Material plan (BOM)
new-order-bom.body: How much fabric and how many accessories the chosen garments need, and whether stock covers it. A shortage is flagged before you save.

new-order-submit.title: Saving
new-order-submit.body: Once the order is created the materials are reserved and the card appears in the first column of the board.

clients-search.title: Finding a client
clients-search.body: Part of a name or phone number is enough — the list filters as you type.

clients-table.title: The client list
clients-table.body: Click a column header to sort; clicking a row opens the client with their measurement history, orders and outstanding balance.

clients-new.title: New client
clients-new.body: A name and a phone number are enough. Measurements are added later on the client's page and every version is kept in the history.

inventory-table.title: Stock list
inventory-table.body: Fabric and accessory balances, cost and reorder point. A row turns to the warning colour once it drops below that point.

inventory-add.title: Intake and edits
inventory-add.body: Add a new material or record an intake/write-off against an existing one — every movement leaves a trace in the Movements ledger.

nav-dashboard.title: Dashboard
nav-dashboard.body: The shape of the day: active orders, this week's fittings, revenue and stock alerts. Most days start here.

nav-orders.title: The Orders section
nav-orders.body: The workshop's main work in one group: the kanban board, the full list and order creation.

nav-orders-board.title: Kanban board
nav-orders-board.body: Orders laid out in columns by stage. Drag a card into the next column and the status follows.

nav-orders-list.title: All orders
nav-orders-list.body: A table with filters and sorting by date, client, amount and status — the quickest way to isolate unpaid orders.

nav-orders-new.title: New order
nav-orders-new.body: Client, garments, measurements, price and dates — all on a single page.

nav-clients.title: Clients
nav-clients.body: The client base: contact details, measurement history, past orders and the outstanding balance.

nav-inventory.title: Warehouse
nav-inventory.body: Fabrics, accessories and every movement behind them. The number beside it counts items that fell below their reorder point.

nav-fabrics.title: Fabrics
nav-fabrics.body: Balance in metres, cost and reorder point. Intakes and write-offs are recorded right here.

nav-accessories.title: Accessories
nav-accessories.body: Buttons, thread, zips and the rest — tracked exactly like fabrics.

nav-movements.title: Movements ledger
nav-movements.body: Every intake, consumption, reservation and release: when, by whom and for which order.

nav-catalog.title: Garment types
nav-catalog.body: Dress, suit, chapan… Each type carries a standard material usage (its BOM) and a turnaround time — that is what an order's calculation is built from.

nav-settings.title: Settings
nav-settings.body: Staff, roles and system activity. The group only appears for those with the matching permissions.

nav-staff.title: Staff
nav-staff.body: Create accounts, assign roles and revoke access. Staff are never deleted — they are deactivated and their history stays.

nav-roles.title: Roles and permissions
nav-roles.body: This is where each role's view and reach is defined; the menu and the buttons follow it.

nav-activity.title: Activity log
nav-activity.body: Who did what: status changes, payments, stock and setting changes, each with its timestamp.

orders-list-filters.title: Filters
orders-list-filters.body: Search and filter by status. Clicking a column header sorts by date or amount.

orders-list-flags.title: Quick flags
orders-list-flags.body: The "Unpaid" and "Overdue" buttons isolate orders carrying a balance or running late in one click.

orders-list-table.title: The order table
orders-list-table.body: Each row is an order: number, client, status, total and balance. Click a row to open the order.

order-items.title: Garments
order-items.body: Each garment in the order: its measurements, fabric, accessories and the tailor assigned. A single garment's status is changed here too.

order-money.title: Payments
order-money.body: The total, the payments taken and the balance left. A new payment goes in through "Record payment" at the top.

order-schedule.title: Dates
order-schedule.body: Order date, fitting and deadline. Once a deadline passes, both this page and the list flag it in red.

order-status.title: Changing the status
order-status.body: Moves the order to the next stage. Every move touches stock: cutting reserves the materials, completion consumes them.

order-history.title: History
order-history.body: Everything done to this order — status changes, payments and edits — with who did it and when.

client-stats.title: Client numbers
client-stats.body: Total orders, lifetime spend, outstanding balance and the date of the last order.

client-measurements.title: Measurement profiles
client-measurements.body: Each garment type keeps its own measurements. A new set does not overwrite the old one — it stays in the history, so changes can be compared.

client-measure.title: Taking measurements
client-measure.body: Adds a new set. It is the one offered automatically when an order is created.

client-orders.title: Order history
client-orders.body: Every order this client has placed and where each one stands; click a row to open it.

inventory-filters.title: Search and filters
inventory-filters.body: Search by name or filter by stock level, type and status. The total value of the warehouse sits on the right.

accessories-filters.title: Search and filters
accessories-filters.body: Filter accessories by name, type and stock level. On the right: total value and how many items fell below their threshold.

accessories-table.title: The accessories table
accessories-table.body: Balance in pieces, cost and reorder point. Intake, write-off and edits live in the menu at the end of each row.

accessories-add.title: New accessory
accessories-add.body: Add buttons, zips, thread and the rest — with a unit of measure and a reorder point.

movements-filters.title: Movement type
movements-filters.body: Intake, consumption, reservation, release and correction — pick one to narrow the ledger.

movements-table.title: The movements ledger
movements-table.body: Every change in the warehouse: date, type, material, quantity, who did it and for which order. These entries are never deleted.

catalog-grid.title: Garment types
catalog-grid.body: Each card is a type: its standard material usage (BOM), turnaround time and base price. An order's calculation comes from exactly these values.

catalog-new.title: Adding a type
catalog-new.body: Create the garment type, give it a material usage and a turnaround — from then on it can be picked on an order.

catalog-inactive.title: Show inactive
catalog-inactive.body: Types that fell out of use are deactivated rather than deleted, so the history of old orders stays intact. This switch reveals them.

staff-filters.title: Filtering staff
staff-filters.body: Search by name, role and account status.

staff-table.title: The staff list
staff-table.body: Each row carries the person, their role and their last sign-in. Editing and revoking access sit in the row menu.

staff-add.title: Adding staff
staff-add.body: Name, phone, email and role. The password is for the first sign-in — the person changes it themselves afterwards.

roles-list.title: Roles
roles-list.body: Four base roles: Super admin, Manager, Tailor and Inventory clerk. The number beside each counts its active staff.

roles-matrix.title: The permission matrix
roles-matrix.body: What the selected role may see and change. Removing a permission removes the menu entry and the buttons too — and the server checks it as well.

roles-save.title: Saving
roles-save.body: Saved changes reach staff in that role on their next page load. Super admin permissions cannot be changed.

activity-filters.title: Filtering the log
activity-filters.body: Search by staff name or action, or keep a single record type — order, client, stock.

activity-table.title: The activity log
activity-table.body: Every meaningful action in the system: who, when and what. A disputed case can be reconstructed from here.
